info.name: NeedMap-AI — Complete ML Integration (FIXED)
info.description:
✅ Complete API test suite for NeedMap-AI backend (ml-model-integration branch) with working volunteer workflow.

## How to use
1. Run the server: `uvicorn app.main:app --reload` from backend/
2. Run **Setup** folder in order (all 4 requests)
3. Run remaining requests in order within each folder
4. IDs are captured automatically via test scripts

## Setup flow
- Register org → get admin token
- Register volunteer user → get volunteer token  
- Login verification
- Health check

## ML features covered
- Priority scoring (auto on POST /needs, manual trigger, PATCH recompute)
- Text ingestion (LLM extracts category/urgency from raw text)
- Voice ingestion (pre-transcribed text path)
- OCR extraction (EasyOCR on local sample image)
- Volunteer–need matching (composite score breakdown)
- Assignment match_score auto-computation
